findings.passage: As a Texan, we are on the Frontline of election manipulation. There are so many systems in place to create voter suppression. Here are my beliefs in order of importance:
findings.note: Answer to Ballotpedia Candidate Connection question 'What legislation would you enact related to election administration in the United States?' Date is approximate (2026 cycle; exact survey date not shown). Followed by a list: one person one vote by eliminating the electoral college, federal paid holiday for election day, year-round voter registration and correction, more voting locations, free transport to voting locations, and the one-hour voting allowance extended to early voting. No mention of ID or citizenship proof.
